The '''''Black 2 & White 2'' arc''' (Japanese: '''ブラック２・ホワイト２編''' ''Black 2 & White 2 arc''), also referred to as '''''The 11th Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第十一章''' ''The Eleventh Chapter''), is the eleventh story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It began serialization in July 2013, and ended in April 2020.

This arc follows the adventures of {{adv|Blake}}, a member of the [[International Police]] seeking to arrest the [[Seven Sages]] of [[Team Plasma]], and {{adv|Whitley}}, a former {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}} hiding under a civilian guise in [[Aspertia City]]. Unknowing of each other's true colors, both of them end up attending the same class at the Aspertia [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]]. At the same time, Team Plasma, led by [[Colress]], is planning to exact an ice-cold revenge on the entire [[Unova]] region for their defeat at the end of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}.

{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
* Blake's {{TP|Blake|Genesect}} ([[PS528]])
* Blake's {{p|Keldeo}}, [[Kelden]] ([[PS532]])
* Blake's {{p|Kabutops}}, Kabutott ([[PS537]])
* Blake's {{p|Gliscor}}, Glisott ([[PS537]])
* Blake's {{p|Shelmet}} ([[PS543]])
* Whitley's {{p|Karrablast}} ([[PS543]])

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
* White's {{p|Solosis}} into {{p|Duosion}} prior to ([[PS541]])
* Blake's {{p|Karrablast}} into {{p|Escavalier}} ([[PS543]])
* Whitley's {{p|Shelmet}} into {{p|Accelgor}} ([[PS543]])

===Trades===
The following Pokémon are traded away:
* Blake's {{p|Shelmet}} is given to Whitley for her {{p|Karrablast}} ([[PS543]])

===Releases===
The following Pokémon are released back into the wild:
* Black's {{TP|Black|Reshiram}} ([[PS547]])

==Gym Battles==
No Gym Leaders are challenged.

==Trivia==
* At 6 years and 8 months, this is the longest arc to finish serialization.
